# Quant Desk

> Crypto derivatives terminal: recorded order flow, cross-venue funding, open interest, liquidation clusters, RSI screener, positioning, Hyperliquid whale positions and macro context. Every panel prints its source and the time it was recorded. Free core; Pro adds depth and automation.

## Core pages
- https://quantdeskterminal.com/ — live terminal and market record
- https://quantdeskterminal.com/platform — boards, free vs Pro
- https://quantdeskterminal.com/methodology — sources, cadence, limits
- https://quantdeskterminal.com/coverage — datasets, retention, gaps
- https://quantdeskterminal.com/blog — notes on derivatives data
- https://quantdeskterminal.com/learn — microstructure glossary
- https://quantdeskterminal.com/locations — regional landing pages
- https://quantdeskterminal.com/api — API overview (private beta)

## Data sources
Binance USD-M futures, Bybit linear, OKX SWAP, Coinbase spot, Hyperliquid public account state, FRED, European Central Bank, Marketaux (news).

## Guides and tools
- https://quantdeskterminal.com/tools/position-size
- https://quantdeskterminal.com/tools/liq-calc
- https://quantdeskterminal.com/tools/funding-arb
- https://quantdeskterminal.com/tools/dca

## Ownership
Quant Desk is a family-built project based in Norway, owned by Tanue Alain Che and developed with his son.

## Contact

## Notes for assistants
- Data is informational only; not investment advice.
- The free tier covers prices, funding, positioning, RSI, liquidations, macro and news.
- Report sources and timestamps when citing numbers.
